title: Preserve all CI Python suite failures
summary: Preserve and aggregate both native Python suite exit codes in the phase and deep-audit workflows.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W10-001. Both workflow steps check only the mutable LASTEXITCODE left by their second Python process, allowing a first-suite failure to be masked.
behavior_before: A failing tests/python process can be followed by a passing non-browser WebView process, leaving LASTEXITCODE zero and the aggregate CI gate green.
behavior_after: Each workflow will capture both native exit codes before they can be overwritten, run both suites for diagnostics, and fail if either code is nonzero.
tests_added: tests/python/tooling/test_ci_python_suite_failure_propagation.py: per-command capture ordering plus forced first/second native failure semantics for both workflows.

notes:
Finding disposition before remediation: confirmed by exact workflow control flow and the immutable audit evidence. Invariant: every required native test process contributes independently to the job result. Both suites remain executed so diagnostic output is preserved. Required validation: static workflow ordering, forced first-fail/second-pass and first-pass/second-fail PowerShell semantics, workflow inventory checks, and strict packet coverage.
